name: Elridge Energy Holdings Berhad
overview: 今年公司通过子公司Lumeria Power以4500万令吉收购、安装及调试六条一体化活性炭生产线，进入活性炭生产业务；同时Bio Eneco与Berkana Power签订每年约10万吨棕壳的供应谅解备忘录，并持续更新与PT Orion APAC Indonesia及JFE Shoji Corporation的棕壳供应谅解备忘录状态，后者暂无重大进展。
overview_en: This year the company, through its subsidiary Lumeria Power, acquired, installed and commissioned six integrated activated carbon production chains for RM45.0 million, entering the activated carbon production business;

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 全资子公司Lumeria Power以4500万令吉现金收购、安装及调试六条一体化活性炭生产线。
actions.text_en: Wholly-owned subsidiary Lumeria Power acquired, installed and commissioned six integrated activated carbon production chains for a total cash consideration of RM45.0 million.

model_changes.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
model_changes.text: 通过子公司Lumeria Power以4500万令吉收购、安装及调试六条一体化活性炭生产线，新增活性炭生产业务线。
model_changes.text_en: Through subsidiary Lumeria Power, acquired, installed and commissioned six integrated activated carbon production chains for RM45.0 million, adding a new activated carbon production business line.
